title: ABC Book Spec
description: The interchange contract for a children's ABC / alphabet book. Produced by the zer0-CMS Rails content engine (the wizard), rendered by the zer0-image-generator plugin, and published by drsai into the zer0-mistakes `books` collection. Every field here maps onto book front matter the `book-abc` theme layout understands.

series.description: Book series / category slug. The ABC line is `abc-language`.

theme.description: The subject the alphabet is built around, e.g. 'IT systems'.

audience.description: Drives tone and page density. 'toddler' = board-book single-scroll.

art_style.description: An id from the shared art-style catalog (abc_art_styles.yml).

palette.description: Palette option id; null = the style default.

lettering.description: Big-letter presentation hint for the theme.

art_style_prompt.description: The reusable style tag applied to every plate (denormalised from the catalog for the publisher).

generator.description: Human-readable provenance line for the book colophon.

word.description: The concept the letter stands for, e.g. 'Automation'.

subject.description: A concrete, drawable scene for the word.

tagline.description: The read-aloud line, e.g. 'A is for Automation — robots that help do the work!'.

prompt.description: Composed, text-free raster prompt for the plate.

alt.description: Accessible alt text for the plate.
